categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Develop Advanced Manufacturing Co., Ltd. specializes in the research, production, and sales of specialized components for oil and gas equipment. Its primary product categories include oil and gas production system components, well control device components, and unconventional oil and gas extraction components. The company also extends its manufacturing capabilities to other high-end equipment sectors such as aerospace and nuclear power.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including micro-alloying, deep-sea oil and gas equipment manufacturing, hot extrusion forming, precision forming, heat treatment, ultrasonic phased array testing, and computer-aided process development. It has developed integrated material and manufacturing process technologies, enabling one-stop supply from forged materials to final assemblies. The firm also employs advanced quality control methods adhering to API international standards and has established a national postdoctoral research station.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are major global oil and gas technology service companies such as TechnipFMC, Schlumberger (SLB), Baker Hughes, and Caterpillar. The company serves oil and gas exploration and production sectors, including deep-sea, shale gas fracturing, and high-pressure fluid transport markets. Its products are used in major oil and gas extraction regions worldwide, including Brazil, the Gulf of Mexico, the North Sea, Australia, and the South China Sea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant international sales, especially in the Asia-Pacific region. It has expanded its global footprint through the acquisition of a Singapore-based OEM manufacturer, HME Technologies. Major export markets include Brazil, Singapore, Malaysia, the UK, Romania, France, and Argentina.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Develop operates primarily in the midstream segment of the oil and gas equipment supply chain, focusing on manufacturing specialized components for oilfield equipment. It extends its capabilities along the supply chain by integrating forging, heat treatment, machining, welding, and assembly processes, providing comprehensive one-stop manufacturing services to its customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-value product development, focusing on deep-sea and fracturing equipment components. It invests heavily in R&D to enhance materials, manufacturing processes, and product testing technologies. Current R&D projects include ultrasonic phased array testing for forged parts, multi-directional extrusion forging, nickel-based alloy welding technology, and automated surface cleaning production lines. The firm aims to expand into other high-end equipment sectors and improve digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of customized oil and gas equipment components to large oilfield service companies. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, with sales contracts including both regular orders and long-term framework agreements. Export sales constitute a significant portion of revenue, with transactions settled mainly in RMB and USD.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading supplier of high-end oil and gas equipment components in China and a key Asia-Pacific supplier to global oilfield service giants. It competes with international manufacturers from the US, Italy, and France, leveraging advanced technology and cost advantages. The firm holds a strong position in the deep-sea equipment segment and is recognized for its high-quality, high-pressure, and corrosion-resistant products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.12 billion, a 7.12% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 85.6 million, down 39.9%. Total assets reached RMB 2.76 billion, up 9.5%. The company maintains a stable but cautious growth trajectory amid global economic uncertainties and industry cyclicality, with ongoing investments in capacity expansion and technology upgrades.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Develop emphasizes high-quality, high-performance specialized components capable of withstanding extreme deep-sea oil and gas extraction conditions, including high pressure, corrosion, and low temperatures. Its one-stop integrated manufacturing process, adherence to stringent API standards, and close collaboration with leading global oilfield service companies differentiate it in the market. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality control, and customer-centric customization underpins its competitive advantage.
